# `foxglove sessions recordings add`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](sessions-recordings.md)

```text
Assign a recording to a session

Usage: foxglove sessions recordings add [OPTIONS] <SESSION> <RECORDING>

Arguments:
  <SESSION>


  <RECORDING>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --project-id <PROJECT_ID>
          Project ID (defaults to FOXGLOVE_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID, then saved default_project_id; --project-id= bypasses defaults)

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
